How do hospital charges compare with what Medicare pays for a joint replacement stay?

SELECT round(sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double) * try_cast(avg_submtd_cvrd_chrg AS double)) / sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double))) AS avg_charge, round(sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double) * try_cast(avg_mdcr_pymt_amt AS double)) / sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double))) AS avg_medicare_payment FROM govblock_health.medicare_inpatient_hospitals_by_provider_and_service WHERE source_file LIKE '%DY21%' AND drg_cd = '470'
Which states employ the most public school teachers?

SELECT statename, round(sum(try_cast(teachers AS double))) AS teachers FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_059 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many rural health clinic cost reports cover fiscal 2023?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS n FROM govblock_health.hcris_rhc17_nmrc WHERE cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023'
Which states have the most onshore wind capacity?

SELECT state, round(sum(mw)) AS wind_mw FROM (SELECT state, plant_code, generator_id, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable WHERE technology = 'Onshore Wind Turbine' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many votes were cast for president in Wisconsin in 2016?
SELECT sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'WISCONSIN' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2016'
Where in a patent are compounds found most often: description, claims, abstract, title or images?

SELECT f.field_name, count(*) AS mentions FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patent_compound_map AS m JOIN govblock_chemistry.surechembl_fields AS f ON cast(f.id AS varchar) = cast(m.field_id AS varchar) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many final rules were published each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT substr(issue_date, 2, 4) AS year, count(*) AS rules FROM govblock_regulations.federal_register_documents WHERE doc_type = '"RULE"' AND substr(issue_date, 2, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which models have the most complaints that involved a crash?
SELECT concat(maketxt, ' ', modeltxt) AS model, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints WHERE crash = 'Y' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many particle entries does the Particle Data Group list?
SELECT count(DISTINCT name) AS particles FROM govblock_physics.pdg_pdgparticle
Which fields of activity have the most registered nonprofits?

SELECT CASE substr(ntee_cd, 1, 1) WHEN 'A' THEN 'arts and culture' WHEN 'B' THEN 'education' WHEN 'C' THEN 'environment' WHEN 'D' THEN 'animals' WHEN 'E' THEN 'health care' WHEN 'F' THEN 'mental health' WHEN 'G' THEN 'diseases' WHEN 'H' THEN 'medical research' WHEN 'I' THEN 'crime and legal' WHEN 'J' THEN 'employment' WHEN 'K' THEN 'food and agriculture' WHEN 'L' THEN 'housing' WHEN 'M' THEN 'public safety' WHEN 'N' THEN 'recreation and sports' WHEN 'O' THEN 'youth development' WHEN 'P' THEN 'human services' WHEN 'Q' THEN 'international affairs' WHEN 'R' THEN 'civil rights' WHEN 'S' THEN 'community improvement' WHEN 'T' THEN 'philanthropy' WHEN 'U' THEN 'science' WHEN 'V' THEN 'social science' WHEN 'W' THEN 'public and societal benefit' WHEN 'X' THEN 'religion' WHEN 'Y' THEN 'mutual benefit' ELSE 'unclassified' END AS field, count(*) AS organisations FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_eo_bmf GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Georgia's 2020 presidential vote was cast by mail?

SELECT mode, sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'GEORGIA' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Where has formal Clean Water Act enforcement been heaviest, state by state?
SELECT substr(npdes_id, 1, 2) AS state, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_formal_enforcement_actions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of U.S. patents are design patents rather than utility patents?
SELECT patent_type, count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states have the most sections of law in the library?
SELECT state, count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many home loans were made in New York State in 2012?
SELECT count(*) AS loans FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar_2007_2017 WHERE cast(as_of_year AS varchar) = '2012' AND state_code = '36' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1'
Which states have the most registered hazardous waste handlers?
SELECT state_code, count(*) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_facilities GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people in the Bronx live below the poverty line?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36005' AND variable = 'B17001_E002'
Which cities are served by the most separate water systems?

SELECT concat(city_served, ', ', state_served), count(DISTINCT pwsid) AS systems FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_geographic_areas WHERE city_served IS NOT NULL AND concat(city_served, ', ', state_served) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many pages does a government form run on average?
SELECT avg(pages) AS average FROM govblock_reference.forms WHERE pages > 0
Which counties had more deaths than births in 2023 by the widest margin?
SELECT ctyname, stname, try_cast(naturalchg2023 AS double) AS natural_change FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '50' ORDER BY 3 ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What was ERCOT's peak hourly electricity demand in 2023?
SELECT max(try_cast(value AS double)) AS peak_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_eba_data WHERE series_id = 'EBA.ERCO-ALL.D.H' AND period LIKE '2023%'
In which languages does ChEBI give the most international nonproprietary names?
SELECT language_code, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_names WHERE type = 'INN' AND language_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the highest system-wide hourly load in ERCOT's weather-zone forecasts?
Ercot Load Forecast By Weather Zone Cdr Lfcweathernp
SELECT max(try_cast(systemtotal AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.ercot_load_forecast_by_weather_zone_cdr_lfcweathernp
Which therapeutic areas draw the most industry research payments?

SELECT product_category_or_therapeutic_area_1, sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_research WHERE product_category_or_therapeutic_area_1 <> '' AND product_category_or_therapeutic_area_1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many applications build on a provisional application filed earlier?
SELECT count(DISTINCT application_number) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_continuity_parents_25 WHERE continuation_type = 'PRO'
Which companies hold the most approved drug products?
SELECT applicant_full_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_products WHERE applicant_full_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How do the two chambers of the Texas legislature compare in size?
SELECT chamber, count(*) AS members FROM govblock_geo.legislature_members WHERE state_file LIKE 'tx-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What were the largest withdrawals from the Treasury's cash account over fiscal 2024?

SELECT transaction_catg, try_cast(transaction_fytd_amt AS double) AS millions FROM govblock_treasury.deposits_withdrawals_operating_cash WHERE record_date = '2024-09-30' AND transaction_type = 'Withdrawals' AND transaction_catg NOT LIKE '%Total%' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many students were enrolled in U.S. public schools in 2024-25?
SELECT sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total'
Which states have built the most solar photovoltaic generating capacity?

SELECT state, round(sum(mw)) AS solar_mw FROM (SELECT state, plant_code, generator_id, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable WHERE technology = 'Solar Photovoltaic' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of recorded solar installations change from 2012 to 2022?

SELECT substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_tracking_the_sun WHERE substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2022') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which industries do prime awards that pass work to sub-awardees come from most often?
SELECT naics_description, count(*) AS subawards FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search WHERE naics_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many SAM.gov registrants are veteran-owned?
SELECT count(DISTINCT unique_entity_id) AS n FROM govblock_awards.sam_entity_business_types WHERE business_type_code = 'A5'
Which materials carry the strongest magnetization per formula unit?
SELECT formula_pretty, try_cast(total_magnetization_normalized_formula_units AS double) AS magnetization FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many atoms does the largest QM9 molecule contain?
SELECT max(natoms) AS highest FROM govblock_chemistry.qm9_molecules
Which publishers run the most journals?
SELECT host_organization_name AS publisher, count(*) AS journals FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_sources WHERE type = 'journal' AND host_organization_name <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many working residents did Puerto Rico have in 2007?
SELECT sum(c000) AS workers FROM govblock_labor.lodes_rac WHERE state = 'pr' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2007
Which organisms are tested in the most ChEMBL assays?
SELECT assay_organism, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_assays WHERE assay_organism IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many skilled nursing facility cost reports were filed for fiscal year 2025?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS reports FROM govblock_health.hcris_snf10_nmrc WHERE hcris_fy = '2025'
Which states have the most clinicians opted out of Medicare?
SELECT state_code, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_opt_out_affidavits WHERE state_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the personal saving rate in April 2020?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS saving_rate FROM govblock_economy.bea_nipa_nipadatam WHERE seriescode = 'A072RC' AND period = '2020M04'
Which large cities have the highest adult obesity rate?

SELECT concat(locationname, ', ', stateabbr) AS city, try_cast(data_value AS double) AS percent FROM govblock_health.cdc_places_place WHERE measureid = 'OBESITY' AND datavaluetypeid = 'AgeAdjPrv' AND try_cast(totalpopulation AS double) >= 500000 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
